description.value: Pure Delight Café is a Vietnamese restaurant in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood serving authentic Vietnamese cuisine including pho noodles, located on the south side of West Broadway between Trutch St. and Blenheim St. The restaurant emphasizes regional diversity in Vietnamese cooking and community connection within the Kitsilano area. It offers dine-in, pickup, and delivery options.
